name: Grand Noah Queen
source:
The Grand Noah Queen is the tenth queen of the Grand Noah kingdom. Her kingdom is known for its high tolerance of Monsters although she personally has a dislike for the "entertainment" that takes place at the Colosseum, wishing for a return of honor to the ring. 

[From [url=https://mgq.miraheze.org/wiki/Grand_Noah_Queen]Mon-musu Quest Wiki[/url]]
